back_translation: The LORD said to me: "Take a large writing tablet and write on it with an ordinary pen: Maher-shalal-hash-baz."
And I appointed trustworthy witnesses for myself — Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah.
Then I went in to the prophetess, and she conceived and bore a son. And the LORD said to me: "Name him Maher-shalal-hash-baz,
for before the boy knows how to call 'Father' or 'Mother', the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off before the king of Assyria."
The LORD spoke to me yet again:
"Because this people has rejected the waters of Shiloah that flow along gently, and has gone to rejoice with Rezin and the son of Remaliah,

therefore, behold, the Sovereign Master is about to bring the mighty and abundant waters of the Euphrates River up over them — namely, the king of Assyria with all his overwhelming pomp — and it will overflow all its channels and flood over all its banks.
It will sweep into Judah, flooding and surging through, rising up to the neck; and its outspread wings will cover the whole breadth of your land — O Immanuel!"
Band yourselves together, O peoples, and be crushed to pieces! Give ear, all you distant lands. Strap on your weapons, and be crushed to pieces! Strap on your weapons, and be crushed to pieces!
Devise a plan — it will be made to fail; proclaim a decree — it will not succeed. For God is with us.
For this is what the LORD said to me, warning me not to walk in the way of this people, when His hand was upon me with power:
"Do not call conspiracy everything this people calls conspiracy. Do not fear what they fear, and do not be shaken.
But the LORD of Hosts — He is the one you must regard as holy. He is the one you must revere; He is the one you must dread.
Then He will be a holy sanctuary; but for both houses of Israel He will be a stone of stumbling and a rock-crag of falling, a trap and a snare for the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
Many will stumble over that stone; they will fall and be shattered; they will be caught in the snare and taken away."
Roll up the testimony and keep it; seal the law among my disciples.
I will wait for the LORD, who is hiding His face from the house of Jacob; I will put my trust in Him.
Behold, I and the children whom the LORD has given me are signs and indicators in Israel from the LORD of Hosts, who dwells on Mount Zion.
When someone tells you, "Go consult the mediums and the spiritists who chirp and mutter" — should not a people consult their God? Should one consult the dead on behalf of the living?
To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.
They will drift through the land, hard-pressed and hungry; and when they are famished they will fly into a rage, and looking upward they will curse their king and their God.
Then they will look down at the earth — and behold, only hardship and darkness, the gloom of utter anguish; and they will be shoved away into thick darkness.

Yet nevertheless, the gloom will not remain on those who once suffered anguish. In the former time He brought the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali low, but in the latter time He will bring honor to the way by the sea, the region east of the Jordan — Galilee of the nations.
